item.title: Pope Leo in Uruguay to kick off South America tour just weeks after lung surgery
item.description: Pope Leo began an emotionally charged tour of South America on Friday, returning to a continent that helped shape his priesthood just three weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery. The 71-year-old head of the Catholic Church will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru over 12 days in one of the most intense papal foreign trips in decades, meeting political leaders, prisoners, the poor, as well as old friends. “I’m very happy to be here,” Leo told reporters on the plane before landing in Uruguay,... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: A diez mil metros de altura, León XIV se ha mostrado pletórico por su primer viaje a América Latina. Ha ironizado con los periodistas sobre cuántos dudaban de que pudiera hacer este viaje, habla de cómo le ha cambiado su cáncer y también de su voto en las elecciones americanas. «Estoy orgulloso de ser americano y de ejercer mi derecho a votar», ha asegurado.Ha entrado en la zona reservada a los periodistas a las 8:42 de la mañana, después de una hora y media de vuelo y de terminar el desayuno. «Estoy muy contento de hacer este viaje, sé que algunos tenían dudas sobre si este viaje llegaría a… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: María Corina Machado visita a las familias de presos políticos a las puertas de la cárcel de El Rodeo
item.description: María Corina Machado continúa su gira por Venezuela tras su retorno del exilio. item.title: 'Mega heat waves' strengthened by interaction between soil moisture, atmospheric pressure and temperature
item.description: A new study has found that a self-reinforcing interaction between temperature, soil moisture and atmospheric pressure is being triggered at high temperatures, making extreme heat waves 10% hotter than they would otherwise be. The study was published in Science Advances and led by the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK) and the International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA). Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Fruit fly study offers clues to insect survival in a hotter, drier world

item.title: ‘A global political awakening’: how gen Z protests are sweeping the world
item.description: From Serbia to Bangladesh and India to France, young people are pushing back against authoritarianism and reshaping political landscapes In Brazil, they rallied online by the millions, sharing videos and spreading memes. In Serbia, they cycled across Europe and ran ultramarathons to make their voices heard. Both movements burst into international public view last month as they became central during election campaigns to the pushback against authoritarianism. What they also offered, however, was a window into a wider phenomenon playing out across the globe, as youth-led movements reshape… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
